quote: Position rows 52, 53, 234, 235, 252 and 253 hold only small values, so the policy has almost no sense of where the car is.
say: Claude reads the input weights and finds the network barely looks at position.

check.note: Those six rows peak at 0.12–0.24, against a typical row peak of 0.15. The speed rows it lists reach as high as 2.37.

quote: The car reverses until vx exceeds 1, then coasts right so it doesn't reach the wall at speed.
say: Claude uses a short burst of reverse, then lets the car roll.

check.note: Reverse lasts 4 steps, and sideways speed is 1.27 at the switch.

quote: Past x = 4.15 it switches to full forward, giving about 1.2 of flat track before the ramp.
say: Claude sets the point where the run-up turns around.

check.note: Full throttle starts at step 29, at x = 4.17, and stays on to the end.

quote: By my estimate the green wheel must leave the ramp at about 2.6 m/s or more.
say: Claude estimates the launch speed the jump needs.

check.note: Green left the crest at about 2.5 and still cleared the strip, so the estimate was slightly high.
